metadata.referenceEquation: Span, Lemmon, Jacobsen, Wagner and Yokozeki (2000)
metadata.interpolation: Bilinear in (specific entropy, log density) and (specific enthalpy, log absolute pressure). No extrapolation.

phaseFlags.2: invalid, solid-region or EOS/domain failure; stop gas thrust

metadata.cellPolicy: Reject a cell if any contributing vertex has nonzero phase flag. Liquid and ambiguous boundary cells are conservatively excluded.
metadata.validity: Lookup accuracy is measured against direct HEOS in reference-eos-validation.json. This is not a certified thermal/component model.
